notes: Route priors are explicit missing-route structural assumptions already exercised by the integrated Props validation suite; they are not fitted to 2026 outcomes.
UNKNOWN availability uses a Beta(9,1) structural prior (mean 0.90, effective sample size 10) so missing current-status evidence remains probabilistic rather than being silently treated as AVAILABLE.
QUESTIONABLE and DOUBTFUL priors remain empirically fit from pre-2026 historical injury/snap evidence by the upstream builder when available.
